scripts.setup: npm run build:contracts && npm run db:generate
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names contracts,api,web "npm run dev --workspace=@crowanzas/contracts" "npm run dev --workspace=@crowanzas/api" "npm run dev --workspace=@crowanzas/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build --workspace=@crowanzas/api && npm run build --workspace=@crowanzas/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run setup && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:contracts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:smoke: npm run build:contracts && npm run build --workspace=@crowanzas/api && playwright test
